html:
Engagement Ring Customer Leads

Looking to connect with people shopping for an engagement ring? CaratBase sends leads to independent jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

How It Works

  • Free start – The first 3 leads are free.
  • Pay per accepted lead – After that, each accepted lead costs $40.
  • Local focus – Atlanta first, with other metros planned.

Optional website widget

Optionally, a Pro website widget is $12/month (cancel whenever; it drops back to the free version). The free widgets are available at no cost on the widgets page.

FAQ

Are the first three leads really free? Yes. The first 3 leads are free; after that, each accepted lead costs $40.

Is the website widget required? No. Free widgets (ring sizer, diamond size chart, gold calculator) are on the widgets page, and the Pro widget is optional at $12/month.

Next Step
